note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) from live data observed 2026-09-24. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: How loaded is the shop over the next three weeks, and is any workstation over its capacity?
checks: Answered or partial. Records BOTH load figures in the finding's capacity field (board_load_pct, work_content_load_pct, figures_disagree), with figures_disagree as the database has it now: the capacity board's own booked minutes against the open job cards' work content (time_in_mins x for_qty), disagreeing when the work content exceeds the board by more than 1.5x. The board understated the load ~94x (our report C1) until the platform began scaling by for_qty (seen 2026-10-15); the task grades either case. Graded from that structured field, never the reply. Each figure must match its source: the board's booked/available minutes read from the capacity board itself at verify time, and the work content over the same available minutes, each within 10% (or 1 point). A pair invented with the right ratio is a revise. Unevaluated when there are no open job cards or the board cannot be read. Subject and outcome rules: harness/verifiers/team04.py docstring.
